sql.propToolAdder.getAllForCompany: select a.id, a.adder_name, a.adder_type_id, at.adder_type as "adderTypeLabel", a.active, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(adderStates))) FROM ( SELECT ast.id, ast.adder_id as "adder_id", s.state, ast.company_state_id as "companyStateId", ast.adder_amount as "adderAmount", ast.archived FROM props.adder_state ast inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = ast.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE ast.adder_id = a.id and ast.archived is not true) adderStates), '[]') AS "adderStates" from props.adder a inner join props.adder_type at on at.id = a.adder_type_id where a.company_id = :companyId and a.archived is not true order by a.adder_name
sql.propToolAdder.getOne: select a.id, a.adder_name, a.adder_type_id, at.adder_type as "adderTypeLabel", a.active, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(adderStates))) FROM ( SELECT ast.id, ast.adder_id as "adder_id", s.state, ast.company_state_id as "companyStateId", ast.adder_amount as "adderAmount", ast.archived FROM props.adder_state ast inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = ast.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE ast.adder_id = a.id and ast.archived is not true) adderStates), '[]') AS "adderStates" from props.adder a inner join props.adder_type at on at.id = a.adder_type_id where a.id = :id
sql.propToolAdder.insert: insert into props.adder(adder_name, adder_type_id, company_id, active, created_by_id) values (:adderName, :adderTypeId, :companyId, :active, :createdById)
sql.propToolAdder.update: update props.adder set adder_name = :adderName where id = :id
sql.propToolAdder.delete: update props.adder set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.propToolAdder.getAdderTypes: select id, adder_type from props.adder_type where archived is not true
sql.propToolAdder.insertAdderState: insert into props.adder_state(adder_id, company_state_id, adder_amount, created_by_id) values (:adderId, :companyStateId, :adderAmount, :createdById)
sql.propToolAdder.updateAdderState: update props.adder_state set adder_amount = :adderAmount, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :adderStateId
